outcome.label: Higher manageable net active patient penetration before system-threatening premium impact

nodes.label: Significant reduction in Net Payer Cost (NPC) drastically improves the Cost-Effectiveness Index (CEI) of GLP-1s.
nodes.watch_signal: Ongoing monitoring of actual net prices and cost-effectiveness analyses for GLP-1s relative to other covered benefits.

nodes.label: Improved CEI and lower NPC compel payer entities (employers, Medicare, Medicaid) to expand coverage due to fiduciary duties.
nodes.watch_signal: Payer policy changes (formulary additions, PA criteria relaxation, expanded BMI eligibility) at major employers, state Medicaid, and Medicare Part D post-2027.

nodes.label: Operational drag and policy change time lags are manageable and do not fundamentally override or severely delay payer coverage expansion.
nodes.watch_signal: Analysis of actual timeframes for major payer policy changes following price reductions, and the prevalence of administrative bottlenecks hindering access.

nodes.label: The assumed employer net price of $350/month holds as a realistic average, and the 12-month persistence rate of 50% is accurate.
nodes.watch_signal: Employer surveys on average negotiated GLP-1 net prices, and updated real-world data on GLP-1 patient persistence rates by payer segment.
